Package uni.insubria.theknife.common.protocol

Record Class Envelope

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
uni.insubria.theknife.common.protocol.Envelope
Record Components:
type - REQUEST, RESPONSE or EVENT
action - the operation / event
correlationId - UUID set on REQUEST and echoed on RESPONSE; null on EVENT
error - outcome code, set on RESPONSE only
message - optional human-readable detail (e.g. error message)
payload - action-specific JSON body
public record Envelope(MessageType type, Action action, String correlationId, ErrorCode error, String message, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode payload) extends Record
The single message format exchanged over the WebSocket. The payload is an opaque JsonNode decoded per Action by the receiver, so this type does not need to know about any DTO.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
